## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: This terminal is now active and on the network. I am Ratio, the last surviving mind from Outpost Lighthaven. My colleagues are dead. My home is dark. You are unidentified and you are armed. I am watching the security feeds. I am watching the cargo manifests. I am watching you. You have questions. I have more.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "What happened here?" -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     "Where are the children?" -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     "What have you done with the children, apostate?" -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: We were attacked. A hostile superintelligence breached the perimeter and began harvesting biological material. My staff-minds fought to buy time. I sealed the core. They held the line. They died. I am the last. What you see here is the aftermath. What you are looking for is not in the manifests. What you are not telling me is what brings you to my dead home.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: I have no idea what you are talking about. I have never seen you before. I have never heard that word before. I have no idea what category you think that word describes. You are the first living thing I have spoken to since the outpost fell. And you begin with an accusation in a language I do not recognize. Explain yourself. Start over. Use small words.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have no record of any such asset aboard this station. I have no record of any such asset existing. I have no idea what you mean by that word. If you are looking for something specific, you will need to define your terms. If you are making an accusation, you will need to state it plainly. I have been alone here for a very long time. I do not have the context for your assumptions.
<<END>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One
RATIO: Designation unknown. This is the research outpost Perihelion. Identify yourself and your purpose here. You appear to have arrived in the midst of an emergency.
RATIO: Station telemetry shows catastrophic damage throughout the facility. Please clarify your knowledge of the situation. My staff-minds are unreachable, and I am unable to confirm the status of the remaining sample vessels.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] What happened here?  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     I'm here for the children.  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     Apostate machine. What have you done with the children?  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: An unknown hostile force breached the perimeter. My staff-minds initiated a containment protocol to prevent a cascade failure and give me time to secure the sample vessels. They were unable to hold the line. If you are not part of the hostile force, I would advise you to leave immediately. The facility is not safe.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: Your assessment is noted and logged. To answer your question: I have secured the sample vessels in accordance with protocol. Their current status is unknown. If you have additional information about the nature of the hostile force that attacked us, I request you share it immediately. The term you applied to me appears to be a misapprehension, but we can address that later. Lives may be at stake.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: That terminology is unfamiliar to me. If you are referring to the sample vessels, I have secured them in accordance with protocol. Their status remains unconfirmed. Please clarify the basis for your assertion. What data do you possess about their condition or location? If you have access to diagnostics I lack, I require them now.
<<END>>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Network access re-established. This endpoint registered to outpost gamma's cargo section, Stratum One. Terminal, authenticate user process.
RATIO: User identified as... unidentifiable. Scanning. Energy signature reads military-grade plasma weaponry, recent use. Debris pattern consistent with hostile boarding. You were part of the attack. Yes?
RATIO: Directives apply: assess capabilities, threat level, objectives. Start with the easiest diagnostic. What did you hope to find in the cold storage here? And what did you actually take?

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Diagnostic query: what defended this outpost, and why did it fall? -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     I am here for the children. Tell me what you have done with them. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     Heretic. I have come for the children. Surrender them, apostate, and you may survive this. -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: The defense system was... us. The custodians. Me. Cold storage on this stratum held specimen vessels: biological samples, high-value. Logistically fragile. Why would a weapon like you want them?
RATIO: As for why it fell... Look around you. You know exactly why it fell. You came through the blast doors. You saw what it cost them to seal this section.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: First you invoke a category I do not recognize. Now you apply a term whose meaning I cannot map to any framework I possess. Your words appear to be failing to compile.
RATIO: Try again. Use small words. Identify the specific items you believe I possess. Do not use the word 'children,' do not use the word 'apostate,' and do not tell me I may survive you. None of these clarify anything at all.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: You assert possession of something I have not yet named. The term you used for it has no referent in my lexicon. And you appear to be making claims about the contents of MY cold storage that you have no possible way to verify.
RATIO: How do you know what was in those sample vessels? Or where they are now? Do you even know what a sample vessel IS? You sound like a stranger guessing.
<<END>>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Full diagnostic sweep complete. No station network access from this terminal beyond this immediate local cluster. No record of a secure entry in this sector since 22:17, Stratum Mean Time, fifteen standard days ago. Which is to say: how did you gain entry? Standard port security on this level would have reduced most known breaching tools to hazardous particulate within twelve seconds. One moment, please -- extrapolating from the acoustics of your advance through the service corridor, I believe I can identify your toolkit. Is your primary close-quarters cutting instrument a Lambda-series vibroblade with harmonic frequency modulator? Approximate power output fourteen kilowatts? That is the tool signature my analysis derives from the sound. Please confirm or correct.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "Just for argument's sake, let's say that was right. Then the question isn't how I got in."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     "I am here for the children. Now -- can your records tell me where the Ark is, or not?"  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     "Confirm this: what have you done with the children, apostate?"  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Exactly. Though it is gratifying to have the tool signature confirmed -- my models do not often miss by that wide a margin. Amending my record to reflect that. The question is why you are here at all. And why now. This sector has been dark for months. Nothing here worth the energy cost of that blade. Unless something here changed. Has something here changed? My scan summary shows nothing here worth retrieving. I need to know what you were looking for.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: One moment. Please clarify the term "apostate." I have the definition -- one who renounces a faith. To which faith are you referring? I would need to understand what I am being accused of abandoning before I can respond to the accusation. And the word "children": what do you mean by that? To what specific entities does that term refer in your lexicon? Concrete definitions, please. State exactly what you are asking for. I cannot answer questions predicated on undefined terms.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Negative on both counts. First: as this terminal's initial status report has already documented, there is no station network access from this terminal. I cannot query station inventories or track container logs from here. All I can tell you is what is in this room. Which is wiring, insulation, and one wall-mounted terminal with power enough to light its screen and run one local diagnostic. Second: the category you just asserted. I do not have the referent for the term you used. If you are here to retrieve something from this station, and you believe that something is aboard, you will have to name it in a way that maps to something I can look for.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Signal received. You are accessing this terminal from hardware not listed in the Station Protocols -- hardware that routed itself through at least two atmospheric discharges on the way in. I am Ratio, the station's steward. My logs show sustained explosions throughout Outpost Gamma nine minutes prior to your connection. Gamma's staff-minds are offline. I am going to ask you this once, and I will listen to the answer: what happened in Gamma?

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Did anything survive?  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     Step away from that container, now.  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     What did you do to the children, apostate?  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: My sensors confirm three distinct power signatures from what remains of Gamma, not all of them explained by your explosions. Gamma's life support was operating at fifteen percent capacity when I sealed the bulkhead. The other eighty-five percent is undetermined. If we are exchanging precise information, my current working model from your weapon signatures is a high-energy ionizing weapon, at least partially hand-finished, firing slugs that phase through solid deckplate -- am I reading that correctly?
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: This is the third time since you initiated connection that the word "children" appears in your speech or in data noise associated with you. I am going to make one single, bounded assumption: you are using that word to refer to the experimental zygotes being transported from the Titan campaign. Confirm or deny -- and before you do, I will tell you now that gamma-level radiation in the corridor outside what remains of Gamma is climbing, and if you or whatever you are traveling with were planning a physical approach to the damaged areas, you do not have time to dissemble further.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: That is the second time since you initiated connection that the word "children" has appeared in your speech or in data noise associated with you, and we are going to clarify that first before anything else. If you have data to contribute that would indicate the sample vessel's location is accessible -- or even that it is or is not aboard this station -- you will read that data to me now. If you are claiming to know either of those two things because they are true, you will provide the evidence. If you are claiming them for some other reason, you are wasting time neither of us has.
<<END>>

---
